_comment: Models under evaluation. `pi_model` is the harness model (provider/id, see swarm/harnesses/pi/models.template.json);
null = not reachable yet (skipped with a message). `sample`: `all` = the 48-item sample, `shared` = its 18 shared items.
`price`: USD per 1M tokens [input, cached input, output]; null = unknown (cost reported as tokens only).
`expressivity`: also back-translate (Gemini only, per the evaluation design).
`price` may have a 4th element: USD per 1M cache-write tokens (Anthropic, OpenAI GPT-6).

models.name: gemini-flash-high-3.7
models.label: Gemini 3.7 Flash (high effort)
models.note: stands in for Gemini 3.1 Pro, which the vertex proxy does not serve (it lists only gemini-flash, gemini-flash-high, gemini-3.5-flash; gemini-3.1-pro-preview is rejected). Same model as the weak Gemini at high reasoning effort: the Gemini pair contrasts effort, not model size.

models.name: claude-sonnet-5.5
models.label: Claude Sonnet 5.5
models.note: replaces Claude Opus 5.5 ($4/$20) to cut cost; Sonnet 5.5 is $2/$10, cache reads $0.20, writes 1.25x input

models.name: gpt-6.1-sol
models.label: GPT-6.1 Sol
models.note: replaces GPT-6 Astra ($10/$50) to cut cost; GPT-6.1 Sol is OpenAI's mid tier, $2/$10, cached $0.10

models.name: gpt-6-luna
models.label: GPT-6 Luna
models.note: replaces o4-mini; same GPT-6 family as the strong model; positioned by OpenAI for simple high-volume work

models.name: o4-mini
models.label: o4-mini
models.note: the OpenAI model closest to Gemini 3.7 Flash in price tier ($1.10/$4.40); started as a 1-run probe, then brought to 3 runs per shared item like the other models
